name: Subnet Calculator
summary: Calculate subnet details from an IP address and mask or prefix.
description: Enter an IPv4 address plus a dotted subnet mask or CIDR prefix to get network, broadcast, host range, and usable addresses.

faqs.question: Can I use /24 instead of 255.255.255.0?
faqs.answer: Yes — enter a prefix like /24 or 24 in the mask field.

faqs.question: What about /31 and /32?
faqs.answer: Special cases are handled; usable host counts reflect point-to-point and single-address subnets.
